text: Tucked along a quiet, flat block in the heart of Noe Valley, this impeccably designed 2-bedroom + den, 3.5-bath residence offers 2, 655 square feet of luxurious indoor-outdoor living. Designed to live like a single-family home, this two-level garden unit features a private entrance, elevator access to all levels, one-car garage parking with EV outlet, and an exclusive backyard oasis that blends privacy, nature, and sophistication. A thoughtfully designed reverse floor plan places the main living spaces on the garden level, creating seamless walk-out access to a beautifully landscaped private yard. Oversized sliding glass doors bring in natural light and greenery, blurring the boundary between indoors and out. At the heart of the home, a dramatic Lilac Da Vinci marble island anchors the chef's kitchen, complemented by rich walnut cabinetry, Thermador appliances, a microwave drawer, wine fridge, and Brizo fixtures. A sculptural Kelly Wearstler pendant adds a bold design statement above the island, while the open-concept dining and living areas are ideal for entertaining or everyday living. Wide-plank oak hardwood floors, recessed lighting, built-in speakers, and a stylish powder room enhance the living experience. The private backyard is a tranquil retreat, thoughtfully designed with low-maintenance turf, mature landscaping, and a full irrigation system-perfect for outdoor dining, weekend lounging, or quiet evenings under the stars. Upstairs, the sunlit primary suite is a serene escape with oversized windows framing lush greenbelt views. Custom millwork offers integrated storage and media, while a generous walk-in closet ensures ample wardrobe space. The spa-inspired ensuite bath features warm Acero limestone, dual vanities, a sculptural freestanding soaking tub, a curbless walk-in shower with Brizo fixtures, and a private water closet. A spacious private deck with sleek glass railings and oversized slate tiles extends directly off the primary suite, offering a peaceful connection to the greenery beyond and a perfect place for morning coffee or evening unwind. An additional ensuite bedroom is well-proportioned and thoughtfully finished, with a generous closet and a designer bath featuring premium tile and a glass-enclosed shower. The flexible den includes its own closet and full ensuite bath with a soaking tub, making it ideal for use as a guest suite, nursery, or home office. Blending comfort, style, and a rare connection to nature, this home offers refined living in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods-just steps from the heart of Noe Valley. Situated in the heart of Noe Valley, it offers the ideal balance of classic city charm and modern lifestyle amenities. Just steps from the vibrant 24th Street corridor with its popular shops, cafes, and farmers market, and within easy reach of the Mission, Dolores Park, and the dynamic energy of Valencia Street. With a Walk Score of 99 and outstanding access to public transportation, this location puts the very best of San Francisco at your fingertips.

text: Prime Parkside! This beautifully remodeled center-patio home with a lush garden is a true gem, ideally located just around the corner from the fabulous Pine Lake Park. Meticulously maintained by the same family for over 57 years, the home reflects true pride of ownership. Thoughtful upgrades include a spectacular remodeled eat-in kitchen, updated electrical, plumbing, heating, and roof, plus the addition of a security system, solar panels, and an EV charger. Architectural details such as high ceilings, elegant archways, hardwood floors, and classic moldings have been exquisitely preserved. The main level offers an ideal floor plan with a spacious living room, formal dining room, fabulous kitchen, center patio, two large bedrooms with garden views, and a bathroom with double sinks and a stall shower. The lower level includes a legal room and full bath. Bright and sunny, this space overlooks the beautifully landscaped walk-out backyard, which features a tiled patio, mature plantings, and a lush lawn, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. MAIN LEVEL The welcoming FOYER , complete with a coat closet, offers a generous entry into the home and opens into a stunning LIVING ROOM with dramatic cathedral-style ceilings and plaster inlay. This elegant space showcases classic detailing: newly refinished hardwood floors, a fireplace with original mantle, and beautiful archways that give the home a feeling of timeless grace. The FORMAL DINING ROOM features a large picture window facing the CENTER PATIO , beautiful ceiling detail, and easy flow into the kitchen, perfect for entertaining or everyday gatherings. The CENTER PATIO is a charming architectural detail that brings natural light into the dining and kitchen areas, while also offering a private, sunny space to enjoy a morning coffee or potted garden. The stunning modern REMODELED KITCHEN is a light-filled space with a skylight, granite countertops, Italian tile, custom cabinetry with recessed under-cabinet lighting and glass doors, a custom light fixture, and high-end stainless steel appliances including a Fisher and Paykel refrigerator, 4-burner cooktop, and Jenn Air double oven. A charming breakfast area with a large window makes for the perfect casual dining area. Two spacious BEDROOMS sit quietly at the rear of the home, both with ample closet space and lovely outlooks onto the garden. A beautifully updated FULL BATHROOM with tile, a shower over tub, Grohe showerhead, built-in vanity, and double sinks completes this level. LOWER LEVEL Downstairs, a large ROOM (legally permitted) overlooks the garden and is adjoined by a full BATHROOM with shower over tub. The LAUNDRY AREA with a Whirlpool washer and Samsung dryer, utility sink, and ample space for a folding table, has access to the garden and patio. The spacious GARAGE with storage and an EV charger, features a Maxxus infrared SAUNA . There is ample room for an in-home gym and expansion possibilities. Step outside to a lushly landscaped walk-out GARDEN , a private and peaceful retreat featuring mature plantings, manicured lawn, and tile patio. Whether hosting friends or enjoying a quiet night, this backyard is a rare Parkside treasure. Includes irrigation system. LOCATION Located in desirable Parkside, this home is just a block from Pine Lake Park & near Stern Grove, Lakeshore Plaza, and Stonestown. Top-rated neighborhood schools and nearby MUNI lines, incl Taraval St & Sunset Blvd transit, making commuting simple and efficient.

text: Welcome to 1822 Lyon Street, a modern interpretation of a stately Victorian. This newly formed condominium in Pacific Heights was transformed in 2020 into a peaceful retreat. The home sits at garden level with direct access to a deck and sunny, shared yard. The fully modernized interior comprises two bedrooms, both with en-suite bathrooms, as well as a powder room for guests. An open entertaining space flows directly to the deck and shared yard through grand sliding glass doors offering true indoor-outdoor living. State-of-the-art sound dampening was installed throughout the ceiling creating a serene living experience. The lovely galley kitchen is the perfect place to prepare meals with a Bosch appliance suite, Zephyr wine refrigerator and built-in espresso machine. Designer finishes, newer systems, Doorbird and Nest integration, Hansgrohe water fixtures, central air conditioning and heat, and in-unit laundry complete the living experience. Leased, secure parking is available nearby (buyer to investigate). Located steps from some of the best food and shopping, 1822 Lyon sits at the crossroads of Pacific Heights, Presidio Heights and Laurel Village. This elegant home offers a wonderful sanctuary in the city that you should see for yourself.

text: This stylish two-bedroom bungalow is hidden from the street behind a tall sleek fence offering the perfect private urban oasis. This enchanting residence has an open-concept floor plan and a generous amount of outdoor space making it ideal for entertaining. The private front garden has a lovely sitting area under a canopy of trees, and the rear garden hosts a large deck, planters with mature bamboo and an adorable shed that would be ideal for a home office. The living area has exposed beams and a peaked ceiling giving it a spacious feeling. The modern kitchen has a generously sized island and is open to both the living area and the rear yard, creating an easy flow for entertaining guests. The modern bathroom has been remodeled with a fashionable combination of tile, a sunken tub, linen closet and a washer/dryer nook. Other amenities in this incredibly loveable home include wide plank floors, exposed beams, new chandeliers, skylights that flood the interior in light, and ample storage in the crawl space. The location is fantastic with easy access to the freeways and just one short block from Cortland shops, The Good Life grocery store and restaurants.

The open-concept living and dining spaces are bathed in natural light from expansive windows and offer terrace and panoramic city views. Hardwood floors, air-conditioning, and in-home laundry complete this sought-after downtown condominium. Located steps from SF's dynamic waterfront, MIRA amenities include 24-hour concierge, fitness center, private dining rooms, rooftop terrace, valet parking, and more.

Smart home upgrades include a Ring doorbell, Insteon lighting, Adobe alarm system, and CAT 5 internet wiring offering enhanced convenience and connectivity. Situated in the vibrant Yerba Buena district, you'll be just moments from world-class dining, shopping, museums, and easy freeway access all while living in a space that honors the city's architectural legacy.

text: This inviting, fully detached 3+BD/3.5BA garden home is nestled on a prized block of Broadway, with sunlit interiors and thoughtfully landscaped outdoor spaces featuring citrus trees and a gently terraced limestone patio on an extraordinary 28-foot-wide by 137.5-foot-deep lot. Located near top schools, Alta Plaza Park, and shops on Fillmore & Union.

text: 1102 Mason Street is 5 unit apartment corner building superbly located in the Nob Hill District of San Francisco, one of the consistently most popular rental and tourist neighborhoods. The corner three bedroom flat would make for a wonderful owner's unit with an eat-in kitchen with retro banquette seating and separate living room. The units have ample sized kitchens and bedrooms and boast lovely natural light due to the building's corner location. The units are separately metered for gas and electricity. Tenants pay for heat and hot water. Soft story seismic work is completed. This is an excellent investment or owner/user opportunity in a fabulous neighborhood with significant upside!

This is a rare opportunity to own a classic Victorian that has been thoughtfully restored for contemporary living.

text: Welcome to 750 2nd Street, a 14-residence boutique building with just two homes per floor and direct elevator access into each apartment. Residence 401 features a 2-bed, 2.5-bath open-concept layout, with a kitchen that anchors the main living area, framed by wood-clad ceilings and walls that add warmth and contrast to the exposed concrete surfaces. The result is a modern, industrial aesthetic with a balanced, refined feel. A wall of floor-to-ceiling windows spans the living and dining space, leading to a private terrace with iconic views of Oracle Park. A sleek linear gas fireplace adds warmth and definition, creating an inviting setting for relaxing or entertaining. The European-inspired kitchen features Caesarstone countertops, a large island, Italian cabinetry, and high-end appliances. The primary suite includes a spa-inspired bath with warm-hued finishes, a quartz-clad vanity, and steam shower. A second bedroom, located at the opposite end of the hallway, includes dual closets with custom cabinetry and access to the adjacent full bath. Additional features include custom closets by California Closets, Plyboo floors and veneers, wine fridge, air conditioning, built-in AV and lighting systems, and in-home laundry. Security features include keypad PIN access to the lobby, elevators, and parking garage, offering a heightened sense of privacy and peace of mind. Ideally located in the heart of South Beach, Residence 401 offers easy access to the best of city living. Just minutes from Oracle Park, the Embarcadero, and an eclectic mix of waterfront dining, the home is also perfectly positioned near MUNI, Caltrain, and major highways for commutes to the East Bay and South Bay. Also convenient to nearby dog parks, South Park, and the marina at South Beach Harbor. Additionally, the dynamic Mission Bay neighborhood and Chase Center are just minutes away, offering year-round access to concerts, sporting events, and green spaces along the waterfront.

text: Ideally situated near Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach, this stunning Sunset home boasts elegance from floor to ceiling. Step into the foyer and be greeted by exquisite wood detailing and rich hardwood floors that flow seamlessly throughout. The living room features classic bay windows that flood the space with natural light, a charming original fireplace, and high ceilings for an airy feel. Adjacent to the living room, the formal dining room is perfect for intimate dinners and lively gatherings. The main upper level includes a well-appointed kitchen, a spacious primary suite with an en-suite bath, two more generously sized bedrooms, and a convenient powder room for guests. On the lower level, two finished rooms offer versatile spaceideal for a home office, gym, studio, or hobby room. Additional highlights include an attached garage and a private backyard, both rare gems in the city. Moments from the best of Irving and Judah Streets, enjoy notable eateries like Arizmendi Bakery, Dumpling Kitchen, Hook Fish Co., and Andytown Coffee Roasters, as well as cultural hotspots including the de Young Museum and Japanese Tea Garden. With easy MUNI access and Ocean Beach minutes away, 1462 29th Ave is the perfect blend of convenience, charm, and coastal living.

text: This recently renovated, stylish Northwest corner condominium at The Summit at 999 Green showcases cinematic views of the Golden Gate, Alcatraz & San Francisco Bay bright by day and dazzling at night! Dark oak floors & abundant natural light from two large walls of glass define the entertaining rooms. Open layout kitchen + dining + living areas combine to share floor-to-ceiling glass walls that slide open to extend the living space outdoors to a dramatic terrace spanning the width of the home. The contemporary kitchen boasts an oversized island with Italian marble, custom European cabinetry, and top-of-the-line Bosch, Miele & Sub-Zero appliances. The primary suite features a glass wall with views of Alcatraz, a marble-clad bathroom with double vanities and large, glass-enclosed shower, as well as a walk-in closet. A second bedroom also enjoys the dynamic panorama and shares the northern terrace. Radiant heat, sophisticated lighting and plentiful storage complete this home. Located at the peak of Russian Hill with sweeping views in all directions, 999 Green is a landmark mid-century hi-rise designed by modernist Bay Area architect, Joseph Eichler. Amenities include a 24-hour attended & ODADA-designed lobby, parking, storage, on-site management, and Resident's Outdoor Plaza.

text: Welcome to 30 Gilroy Street, a modern 5-bed, 3-bath San Francisco retreat with over 2, 200 sq ft of flexible living space. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers a spacious and versatile layout that fits a variety of lifestyles. The upper level features an open-concept design with bay and city views, a generous living room, dining area, and a stylish kitchen with quartz countertops, glass tile backsplash, large island, and stainless steel appliances, including a smart fridge with tablet hub. Three bedrooms and two full baths include a primary suite with walk-through closet and ensuite. Downstairs offers two additional bedrooms, a full bath, a wet bar with wine fridge and storage, and attached 2-car garage with additional backyard access. Thoughtful upgrades throughout include hardwood flooring upstairs, luxury vinyl plank flooring downstairs, espresso-trimmed frosted closet doors, wood slat accents, and a modern fireplace. The terraced, low-maintenance backyard is perfect for entertaining and relaxing in the sun. Smart home features include Ring, Nest, Treatlife lighting, and USB outlets. Conveniently located near multiple parks, walking trails, Caltrain, Highway 101 and 280, with easy access to downtown San Francisco. This home truly has it all!!

text: Nestled in the heart of San Francisco's coveted Laurel Heights-Jordan Park neighborhood, this stunning three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath fully detached home sits on a wide lot, offering both privacy and an elevated sense of scale. A well-designed floor plan can transform a living space, and this home delivers beautifully with its open, airy ambiance created by the thoughtfully crafted split-level design. Updated with contemporary finishes, the residence is bathed in natural light from numerous skylights and windows all around. The formal entry welcomes you into an expansive living room with fireplace, perfect for entertaining, while the sunlit dining room and eat-in kitchen provide an inviting space for gatherings. Premium Bosch appliances and generous cabinetry elevate the heart of the home, combining style and functionality for a seamless culinary experience. Discreetly tucked away on the main level is the half bath. The wrap around, wind-protected rear deck directly off the kitchen features two inviting outdoor seating areas overlooking the landscaped yard and garden-a serene retreat in the heart of the city. A half floor up from the main level is the luxurious primary suite, complete with a spacious walk-in closet, beautifully remodeled bath featuring dual sinks, vanity seating, separate water closet, shower and skylight. The generously sized second bedroom suite enjoys a full bath, large closet, built-in dresser and lovely outlooks. The third en-suite bedroom, a half floor down from the main level, offers garden access and a smartly updated bath with tub. This generously sized ideal guest suite could also serve multi-purposes as an office, media room, family room or home gym. The laundry room and interior access to the garage complete this level. This is truly superb city living.

text: Polished top-floor Edwardian condo tucked away on a picture-perfect street in Mission Dolores! text: Elegant Edwardian condominium in Pacific Heights with private backyard! This lovely two-bedroom residence boasts wonderful period details throughout including wainscoting, moldings, and hardwood flooring. The striking formal living room features a gas fireplace with marble surround, built-ins, and French doors out to a fantastic patio and garden. The eat-in kitchen has been updated with quartz countertops and includes Tuscan-style terracotta tile flooring and a spacious breakfast area. The primary bedroom is filled with light from a west-facing bay window and offers a large walk-in closet, and the 2nd bedroom, which could be used as a formal dining room, has a built-in custom closet. The attractive bath is well-appointed with a double vanity and a shower over Jacuzzi tub, with an adjacent walk-in storage closet off the hallway. The exclusive backyard is beautifully landscaped with mature plants, with a paved area for seating and a standalone, finished studio, great as an office, gym, or storage. The unit includes 1-car independent garage parking, shared laundry, and storage. This 6-unit building is fabulously located just 1.5 blocks from Alta Plaza Park, and a few blocks from the Divisadero corridor, Fillmore St, Mollie Stone's grocery, transportation, and the Presidio.

text: This elegant, six-bedroom Edwardian home - renovated from the ground up in 2007 with seismic, electrical, plumbing, and heating upgrades - blends classic architecture with modern function. Additional amenities include whole-home tech systems, dual water heaters, and irrigation. Located on a coveted block between Pacific Heights and Presidio Heights, with easy access to Alta Plaza, the Presidio, and Fillmore/Sacramento Street shops and dining, 3176 Clay offers the best of city living.

text: On an oversized lot on a rare cul-de-sac, this home arrests your attention immediately with its Emerald dramatic curving terrazzo staircase as though it is inviting you to come up and admire the view. But inside the sunny, well-laid home will make you want to stay forever. Remodeled in 2022, thoughtful touches like subway tile kitchen backsplash, complemented by a fireclay farmhouse sink, a perfect work from home office & huge laundry room make this house liveable even beyond its ample square footage and great 4 bedroom size. Upstairs there are large living and dining rooms, superb chefs kitchen, hall bath, two oversized bedrooms with bay windows & pantry w/stairs down to a 2nd entry hall. This leads to the garage, laundry room & 4th bed and, in the opposite direction, to the primary suite, sitting room, office & 2nd full bath. The sitting room exits to the sheltered, sunny back garden, where veggies, flowers and great times flourish. Close to St. Mary's rec center/ playground, a quick jaunt to shopping on Cortland, Keiko's Coffee and delectable Salvadoran eats on Mission or slightly further to the cozy delights of Glen Park and it's BART station, this home offers all the convenience of the city, the romantic comfort of the past and the space to spread out and enjoy life!

text: First time on the market in more than 50 years! Experience this classic, 1930's Central Sunset home, full of warmth, character, and charm, from its imposing corner presence. Windows throughout fill the home with natural light. Elegant high-coved ceilings, intricate woodwork and parquet floors are just some of the features that define the property. A grand, soaring arched window with elegant panes, the focal point of the living room, and a classic fireplace elevate its elegance. Beautiful arched alcoves flow effortlessly into a formal dining room, complete with window seating. A bright and sunny breakfast room, with built-ins, and an originally tiled kitchen, with a Wedgewood stove enhance the timeless feel. Along the long hallway are 1.5 baths, and ample closets, leading to two spacious bedrooms, which overlook a peaceful west-facing backyard, with ocean views from a distance. On the garage level, there are three rooms and three baths, two with their own private entrances. There is storage, and space for 1-car parking in the center of the garage. There are updated mechanical systems including a hi-efficiency furnace, automatic garage-door opener, and a newer water heater. This home is perfectly situated, blocks from the Noriega, Irving, and Taraval corridors, with excellent transit options and easy highway access. It's also just blocks from local outdoor and sports spaces such as The Sunset Playground and Golden Gate Park. Whether you're a history buff or are seeking modern comfort with classic details, this residence is a rare San Francisco gem ready for its next chapter.

text: Perched atop the historic Hills Plaza, Penthouse #1802 offers inspiring, panoramic views of the shimmering SF Bay, the iconic Bay Bridge, Cupid's Span, Treasure & Yerba Buena Islands, and the rolling East Bay Hills. Ideally located for a full-time residence or pied-a-terre, Hills Plaza is home to Google, Mozilla Firefox, and Wharton School. Stroll to the Ferry Building, Oracle Park along the Embarcadero, or indulge in world-class dining at Epic and Waterbar. Enjoy 24-hour door service, a rooftop terrace, storage, and secure garage parking. With easy access to I-80, I-280, tech shuttles, Muni, BART, CalTrain, and the ferry, this is elevated urban living at its finest.

text: Sophisticated and stylish, this enormous, top-floor Pacific Heights condominium was extensively remodeled in 2017 with distinctive custom finishes. Recent capital improvements include a completed soft-story seismic retrofit and a fully compliant fire alarm system. Gas and electricity are separately metered, and in-unit laundry is available in select units. The corner exposure on both Valencia Street and Clinton Park provides exceptional visibility for the commercial space and prime walkability for residents.

text: Beautifully positioned on a tree-lined block of distinctive homes, this circa 1912 triplex offers exciting prospects for owner-occupants & investors alike. Smart updates combined w/ preserved vintage characteristics keep this grand property well grounded in both past & present. All units showcase hints of a bygone era: lincrusta, gumwood paneling, box beam ceilings, original light fixtures, ornate fireplaces, hardwood floors & oversize windows. The top floor flat (#50) features a 2016 kitchen remodel accented by a vintage Spark stove, center island w/ auxiliary sink & a separate pantry. The middle flat (#50A) underwent a complete kitchen remodel in 2025 plus fresh paint, refinished floors & newly installed wall heaters throughout. The lower flat (#50B) is currently occupied by responsible tenants. Split bathrooms in all units have had moderate updates over the years yet remain largely original & in need of a refresh. The garage level accommodates up to three vehicles in addition to generous amounts of storage. Developers may see potential for adding an ADU. The rear deck & stair assembly has been newly rebuilt & affords all units direct access to the quiet backyard w/ brick patio. Duboce Park, MUNI lines, bike routes & cafes are right outside your door. Nothing else compares

text: This top-floor, 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in a 2-unit building is one of a cluster of late-19th-century structures still standing at the corner of Sutter and Laguna. The lower unit, once Weldon's Grocery, was a mainstay of the neighborhood for decades. The decorative Italianate elements seen on the upper level are all original, while the lower level of the facade was changed by a developer in the late 1980s to mimic the original design, when the building was converted to two units. The current owners have called 1695 Sutter home since 1988. The location is amazing, sitting on the cusp of Japantown, and close to groceries, restaurants, shops, and transportation. Lafayette Park and Peace Plaza are both steps away, while Fillmore Street and Hayes Valley are likewise within walking distance.

Culinary inspiration and community are evident in the professionally appointed eat-in kitchen, a generous gathering place which serves daily meals, frequent visitors, and hospitality of all kinds. text: Perched high above the city on a rare fully detached, double lot in Clarendon Heights, 34 Clarendon Ave offers sweeping panoramic views of the ocean, Golden Gate Bridge, and San Francisco skyline from every level. This 3, 052 sq. ft. residence (per tax records) features 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms across a wide 50-foot frontage, creating a sense of scale and openness rarely found in the city. Floor-to-ceiling glass in the expansive great room frames the dramatic vistas, while a generous view terrace invites indoor-outdoor living. The well-appointed kitchen is outfitted with granite counters, double Miele ovens, Dacor gas cooktop, and Bosch dishwasher. The oversized primary suite and private guest suite on the lower level provide comfort and flexibility with an additional terrace attached to them, and large walk-in showers with floor to ceiling glass overlooking the trees. The home also includes a laundry room and multiple storage closets, and parking in the garage + driveway parking. Tucked in a peaceful hillside setting, 34 Clarendon is a rare blend of scale, light, and world-class views. Home is owner-occupied with many belongings and will not be staged, showings by appointment only.

A huge garage includes a workshop and storage as well as development potential. The intimacy and level walkability of this leafy block of detached homes is a quintessential aspect of Balboa Terrace life: easy access to West Portal, parks, shopping, and West Side amenities such as Stern Grove, Stonestown, and Ocean Avenue retail. Don't miss!

text: Sophisticated mid-century architecture, streamlined contemporary interiors, glorious natural light, and a prime location affording picturesque views combine in this chic four-bedroom residence on Marina Boulevard. The three levels of living space feature lovely white-oak hardwood and terrazzo floors; oversized windows, clerestories, and skylights; modern fixtures and finishes; and views that range from the boats of the marina and the St. Francis Yacht Club to a magnificent full sweep of the bay, from Alcatraz and Angel Island to the Marin Headlands and the Golden Gate Bridge. At garden level are a landscaped entryway, an office or auxiliary bedroom, a bath with a shower, a vast, inviting family room with multiple windows and sliding glass doors offering access to an impossibly green garden shaded by a mature maple tree, and access to the two-car garage. One level above are the welcoming open-plan living and entertaining spaces, which feature sweeping views, a stylishly minimalist wood-burning fireplace with a shimmering Venetian plaster finish, a discreet powder room, and a chef's kitchen with handsome quartzite counters, an eight-burner double-oven Wolf range with a hood, and a sunny breakfast area. Light floods in thanks to numerous windows and sliding glass doors that give way to a private central terrace. Secluded at the end of an atrium-like hall, the principal suite is a peaceful oasis with abundant closet space, terrace access, and a sizeable skylit bath with a generous dual-sink walnut vanity, a walk-in glass-walled shower, and a jetted soaking tub. The elegant curving stairway that links all the levels rises to the uppermost floor and an impressive lounge with a wood-burning fireplace and a preeminent postcard-worthy view enjoyed via a wall of nearly floor-to-ceiling windows. Two bedrooms-one with a similarly enviable view-and a shared bath complete the uppermost level.

text: 956 SVN is a historic grand Italianate Victorian built in 1872 by noted architect Edward Leodore Mayberry. During an extensive 2-year restoration/renovation in 2017, a thoughtful commitment was made to honor its history & artistic accents while upgrading the interior for modern living & a full upgrade in systems including the foundation, electrical, & plumbing. This is a truly unique home, unlike any other on the market -- where high design meets functionality and quintessential San Francisco living. The main level is an entertainer's dream with grand rooms (all w/soaring ceilings), a chef's kitchen, and a sun-filled walkout garden. Up the original preserved staircase are 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a large developed attic (w/ full bath) offering space for a rec room, media room, or guest bedroom. The lower level was completely built out for additional living space w/ a full bath and bedroom (or a future unit with plumbing for a small kitchen). Additional features of this spectacular, fully-detached home include a 2 car side-by-side garage, an 800-bottle wine room, 2 laundry rooms, & abundant storage throughout. Show to your discerning buyers who are tired of the cookie-cutter remodels!

text: DESCRIPTION Welcome to 52 Summit Way! Built in 2014, this stunning top floor two-story house like condo with views seamlessly blends modern elegance with custom luxury upgrades. The bright and sunny living room offers elegance and comfort & opens out to a fabulous view deck. The kitchen is truly fit for a chef with top-of-the-line Viking appliances & lrg island with seating and an abundance of custom cabinetry and encounter space.The dining area offers comfortable seating for at least 10. It features built-in custom cabinetry and counter space. The cabinetry w/ under cabinet lighting and glass cabinets with interior lighting features dramatic mirrored backsplash, reflecting the beauty of the room. The Primary en suite is sumptuous, with fabulous views & walkout deck. It features custom built-in nightstands, headboard, and beautiful lamps and fabulous spa like bathroom. All three bedrooms are large & offer excellent closet space. Two private view decks extend from the living space & primary bedroom, enhancing the home's connection to its picturesque surroundings. Located in one of SF's most desirable areas, 800 Summit boasts a private dog park, playground, & a two-acre park featuring the striking Benjamin Bufano "Peace" sculpture. MAIN LEVEL Upon entry, ascend to an open-concept living space that blends sophistication and warmth. The living room, kitchen, and dining area feature elegant shiplap ceilings, sleek tile flooring, and custom cabinetry.The living room is bright and airy and opens to the beautiful view deck and flows perfectly into the kitchen and dining area.The designer kitchen is a chef's dream, equipped with top-of-the-line Viking appliances, a six-burner range, and a stunning custom tile backsplash. A sprawling central island with a deep stainless steel sink and built-in dishwasher makes meal prep effortless. A built-in oven, microwave, and expansive Viking refrigerator are seamlessly integrated into custom dark wood cabinetry, providing ample storage.The adjacent dining area seats ten, with custom built-in cabinets featuring glass display shelving with interior lighting and under-cabinet lighting offers lovely stone counter tops. Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors lead to an expansive balcony, offering breathtaking golf course views and abundant natural light. A powder room completes this floor. UPPER LEVEL The upper level features three well-appointed bedrooms and two baths, including a luxurious primary suite. The first bedroom is bright and airy, with multiple windows and a spacious closet. The second bedroom is equally well-sized. Both bedrooms share a stylish full bathroom with a dual vanity, modern fixtures, and a tiled shower-over-tub combo. A side-by-side laundry closet completes the level. There is a large garage that offers two car parking spaces.

text: Occupying the highest full floor atop 2006 Washington, this unforgettable apartment underwent a masterful, multi-year redesign & renovation under the leadership of the award-winning team of architect Andrew Skurman, interior designer Suzanne Tucker, and Moroso Construction. With window after window revealing a full panorama that encompasses icons from the Golden Gate past Alcatraz and Coit Tower to the Transamerica Pyramid and beyond, the aerie reclaims magnificent architectural details while sensitively incorporating a globally curated collection of materials and design elements. Every space and amenity has been thoughtfully adapted for today's technologically-oriented sensibility. The beguiling Beaux-Arts building at 2006 Washington Street rivals other distinguished structures in cities around the world. Over the century since its design and construction in 1924 by Conrad A. Meussdorffer, it has garnered a reputation as a legendary landmark, a storied locale whose presence feels larger than life. Tech founders, as well as leaders of finance and industry have called this building their home, and it continues to be admired as one of the most luxurious and powerful collections of residences in its city. Spanning a remarkable 5, 700 square feet, this unparalleled home is the crown jewel of Pacific Heights apartments, destined for spectacular living and entertaining, with majestic, strikingly detailed entertaining spaces that open to a dazzling wraparound terrace. The passenger elevator opens to a vestibule and then an elegant octagonal domed entry hall with a floor of intricately patterned quartzite and marble. Ornamental plaster ceilings by Foster Reeve transcend time and add eye-catching drama to the aesthetic. The scale is grand yet inviting. Soaring ceilings contribute to a lofty ambience in the bespoke living room, which features custom-dyed silk-upholstered walls, a fireplace with an 18th-century Italian mantel, and serene, walnut parquet floors. The dining alcove's mirrored wall allows views to be appreciated at every seat. Contributing to the welcoming air in the family room are Baltic pine paneling with built-ins, a custom-carved marble fireplace, a concealed projector and theater screen, and a stone-clad dry bar. A spacious family kitchen with a quartzite-topped Baltic pine island and striking hand-glazed blue cabinetry occupies the western side of the residence and opens through arched Palladian-style doors to the terrace with picture-perfect vistas of the Golden Gate. A full catering kitchen adjoins the formal dining area and is accessed via a hidden doorway. Each of the two primary bedroom suites is equally luxurious, opens through French doors to terraces, and is accompanied by a generous dressing room and a lavish marble-clad bath. Completing the secluded southern wing is a thoughtfully appointed guest suite. The laundry room offers desirable storage, and the floor plan includes two powder baths, substantial storage and a service elevator. As the city's foremost cooperative, 2006 Washington provides residents with an array of amenities. Its handsome brick drive circles a vibrant, meticulously landscaped garden with a fountain, culminating at a regal porte cochÃ¨re. The lobby is attended full-time and year-round, and ownership conveys parking for two vehicles in a private garage, storage, security, and the knowledge that one's home is perched high atop one of the most revered buildings in the city, at what is surely its most coveted address.

text: Nestled in the heart of Visitacion Valley, this charming home offers versatile living spaces, stunning Bay views, and modern upgrades. text: Welcome to the perfect city pied-a-terre at The Marina Chateau, an iconic 7-story French Revival building in Cow Hollow. Situated on the quiet Greenwich side of the building, there's a noticeable ambiance to Unit 205. All-day sun and the soothing backdrop of a tree-lined street right outside its Bay windows fill this south-facing studio condo. Rich period details like arched doorways and barrel-vaulted ceilings with decorative plaster moldings are displayed throughout the unit, mirroring the Romanesque architectural style of the Chateau's lobby and facade. The circa 1929 floor plan utilizes its 547+/- sq.ft. of living space wonderfully for today; there's division and privacy when you need it and a thoughtfully designed flow to accommodate more than a few. Spacious great room anchors it all together comfortably, with a designated sleeping space and separate lounge area. Formal dining room with ornate style and adjacent galley kitchen can easily host intimate dinner parties or flex as an at-home office. Located off the foyer is a walk-in closet considered large by any measure, providing even more ways to customize, and an Art Deco inspired full bathroom with storage. Dog-friendly building with a wind-protected common area roof deck with panoramic Golden Gate Bridge views.

text: Just over a block from vibrant Cortland Ave, this handsome, renovated 2 bedroom + den, 2 bathroom Midcentury single family home offers meticulous design and modern comforts. Based on designs from Protea Landscape Architects, the terraced garden is a serene retreat with manzanita, succulents, blue sage, verbena, reed grass, and maple tree, all complemented by a decomposed granite path leveled for optimal drainage. The living and dining area blends seamlessly with the kitchen and features a vaulted ceiling with multiple windows creating a bright and airy space. A 2016-17 renovation materially improved the home with a down-to-the-studs kitchen and primary bathroom remodel, guest bathroom refresh, new deck, new sliding door, new tile entry, and a fully re-skimmed main floor for a smooth, modern finish. More recently, the home received a new roof, new interior/exterior paint, and refreshed front/rear gardens. Completing the home is a pristine garage with a newly epoxied floor, two-car parking, and ample storage!

text: Thrive in this charming 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom cottage with bonus spaces and an outdoor haven. A grand foyer welcomes you and serves as the heart of the house, opening to the living room, one of the bedrooms, and the updated kitchen. An office space leads to the generous deck and could be used as a breakfast nook. The upstairs bathroom has been remodeled and includes a bidet and oversized shower. Appreciate the period details like the potbelly stove, decorative baseboards, and restored original wood flooring. The bottom level features even more living space, with a primary suite and a bonus room that could be a study, family room, or third bedroom. Storage abounds, with shelving in the laundry room and a second work space off of the 1-car garage. Imagine entertaining on the large deck with tranquil views of the lush hills or hosting a garden party in the backyard. Low-maintenance turf is child and pet friendly. Test your green thumb with the built-in protective plant cage. When you're ready to leave your private sanctuary, parks, shops, public transportation, and commuter routes are all moments away.

text: Welcome to 340 6th Street, where high-end design meets exceptional craftsmanship in this architecturally distinctive one-bedroom + guest sleeping loft, one-bath residence. Thoughtfully remodeled with meticulous attention to detail, this home exudes style and comfort at every turn. As you enter, you're greeted by exquisite 12-inch wide plank wood floors and high ceilings that set a warm, contemporary tone. The modern chef's kitchen, designed for culinary enthusiasts, features thick Carrara white marble countertops, two integrated dishwasher drawers, a Bertazzoni gas range, a pot filler, and custom natural wood cabinetry. Ascend to the open, airy primary loft suite, where ample storage spaces blend function and elegance seamlessly. A cozy separate loft provides a private space for guests, perfect for hosting friends or family. The bathroom is a stylish retreat, featuring high-end finishes and a thoughtfully designed layout. Convenience abounds with deeded parking and storage located on the same level, just steps from the front door, making urban living effortless. Situated in vibrant SoMa, this home offers easy access to Whole Foods, Caltrain, and freeway entrances, as well as beloved local spots like Deli Board, Sightglass Coffee, Telescope Coffee, and HK Lounge Bistro.

text: Soma Grand residence 2007 is a spacious 2 bedroom/2 bath with dark bamboo flooring in the main areas and luxury carpet in the bedrooms, original Studio Becker cabinets, Bosch range, quartz counter tops and in-unit front loading washer/dryer. The primary suite features a spacious bathroom with double vanity and a walk-in closet. The 2nd bedroom has views forever from the giant corner windows - perfect for work from home or even as a 2nd living room if it is not needed as sleeping quarters. The building's amenties, which include BBQ area, firepit, hot tub, workout room and concierge services are legendary. In addition, there is no more convenient place to live in San Francisco. Take a quick walk to Trader Joe's or San Francisco's unique Rainbow Grocery. With mere steps to the SF Public Library, The Asian Art Museum, The SF Ballet, Davies Symphony Hall, the Yerba Buena Center, SF MOMA and so much more, this location is truly the cultural center of the City. Nightlife of all kinds including music (think Slim's) and some of the best Drag (Oasis and AsiaSF!) in the world are also nearby, as is transportation for when you want to go somewhere else. BART, tech shuttles and 80/101/280 freeway access are all close and there is 1 car parking available for lease in the garage.

text: Apartment No. 3 is Pacific Heights' most spectacular full-floor residence exploiting the harmony of contemporary classical design. The spare-no-expense renovation was completed in 2017 under the direction of award-winning design firm, Skurman Architects. Particular attention was paid to acoustic soundproofing making the apartment a sonic oasis floating above the hustle of city living. All three bedrooms and the media/office room have air conditioning to maintain comfort in these south facing rooms. High-level security, doorman service, 3 parking, two secure storage rooms, and direct elevator service. Located next to Lafayette Park, this residence enjoys immediate proximity to one of San Francisco's grand city parks.

text: Nestled in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods, Parnassus Heights, this remarkable home rich with history has been beautifully reimagined for modern living. Originally built in 1924 by Robert Haight, the property retains its storied charm while embracing a fresh, contemporary design that enhances both form and function. The home features 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms on 2 levels, plus a carriage house at the street level which is currently used as a home office and gym. Design selections include custom lighting, lime wash paint, light colors to balance the abundance of natural light, and perfectly scaled furniture (some pieces could be available for sale separately). A masterful renovation by the designer-owner has opened up the interiors, allowing natural light to flood the space and creating impeccable indoor-outdoor flow. Throughout the residence, soaring ceilings, restored moldings, and carefully curated materials create a sense of balance between old and new. The primary suite offers a serene retreat, with a spa-like bath and expansive city views. Outside, the meticulously landscaped front and rear gardens provide a private oasis in the midst of the bustling city below. Published in Architectural Digest among others.

A private fitness area within the garage adds convenience. The beautifully manicured English garden completes this exceptional property.

This charming home offers the opportunity to live comfortably today or to renovate and potentially expand for the future.

Additional conveniences include garage parking, a large shared storage room, and access to a communal backyard patio. Guest bathroom has a unique shower by a local glass artist. The newly remodeled primary suite includes marble fireplace, luxurious bathroom with marble floor and vanity. This move-in ready townhome comes with a large private one-car garage and spacious storage room. The location offers quick access to the Mission, Noe Valley, Dolores Park, and multiple public transportation options.

text: 263 Texas Street, the lower flat of a 2-unit building, is about connectivity, style, intimacy, flexibility, and living at the center of it all. The beautifully remodeled eat-in kitchen is the nexus of the home, surrounded by a versatile double-parlor and a large rebuilt east-facing deck off of the kitchen that invites indoor-outdoor living. The primary bedroom w/ensuite bath & chic jewel-box powder room cap off the main level. Below the deck is a renovated multi-purpose room outfitted w/ a murphy bed, and windows with natural light & eastern outlooks, perfect for an office or private room for guests to enjoy. Shared areas include the backyard & huge basement storage that spans the footprint of the home. Most find that Texas Street offers abundant parking, and the home is eligible for a neighborhood parking permit. This Texas and 18th Street location is in the heart of Potrero Hill. Connected to all the Hill's favorites, you also have easy accessibility to the best of Dogpatch, Crane Cove Park and the connecting waterfront, plus events at Chase Center and Oracle Park. For transit you are conveniently located near tech shuttle busses, 280 and 101 highways, Caltrain, and the Muni T-line. No other location in the city can provide that combination, and you get the best weather in SF!

text: Located on the iconic Filbert Steps, #221 offers a lifestyle unlike anywhere in San Francisco! With views of the Bay and a harmonious blend of indoor and outdoor living, the home provides a rare sense of privacy and community - surrounded by lush greenery, the Grace Marchant Gardens, and the famed Parrots of Telegraph Hill. The sunlit living room defines the upper level, complete with vaulted, beamed ceilings, a fireplace, and walls of French-pane windows that frame panoramic views from Angel Island to the Bay Bridge. The adjacent kitchen completes this elegant entertaining level. The bedroom on the lower level features custom cabinetry and expansive windows that capture postcard views of the surrounding gardens and the Bay. A full bath adorned with artistically designed, colorful tile adds to the home's enduring character. In-home laundry and a storage room complete the floor plan. Life continues outdoors on a large terrace that spans the width of the home, offering north and east-facing views-an ideal place to enjoy the tranquility of this remarkable hillside setting. Originally constructed in 1907 as an earthquake shack-a term now affectionately used to describe these rare, city-built cottages-this home has been carefully preserved and updated for modern living. text: This beautifully renovated one-bedroom TIC in an eight-unit boutique building offers sophisticated indoor-outdoor living in the heart of Pacific Heights. text: Step into this ultra-chic, full-floor 2BD/2BA residence in a thoughtfully renovated three-unit building located directly across from Golden Gate Park. Just off the kitchen, the airy living and dining areas offer seamless flow for both entertaining and everyday living, complete with a gas fireplace and a wall of windows that frame the park's greenery. The serene primary suite opens to a private rear deck and includes a spa-like bath with designer tile and a floating vanity. Additional highlights include hydronic radiant floor heating, in-unit side-by-side laundry, and one-car off-street parking. Centrally located near the shops and restaurants of NOPA and the Haight, with convenient access to USF, UCSF, and multiple transit options, this home makes it easy to enjoy both city life and the outdoors. You're right where you want to be.

text: The compelling charm of this 1907 home lies in the artful interpretation of its romantic interior architecture, stunning city views, & airy, indoor/outdoor connectivity. The 2 story, 3 bedroom home includes a one bedroom, in-law apartment, occupied by long-term tenants. The best-kept-secret block gives way to a luminous, modernized, residence whose floorplan is organized to take in panoramic views of San Francisco. A generous living room, anchored by a kiva-like fireplace + library, & the luminous formal dining room flow to the city view deck. The professionally-equipped kitchen includes, handsome tile-clad backsplash, quartz counters, extensive storage & a cosy media lounge accessing the deck. A sheltered garden below is lush with mature landscaping, flowering shrubs, tree ferns & orchids. A fresh, sky-lit marble bath completes this level. A skylit stair leads to 3 bedrooms, used as 2 beds + office/lounge. The Bauhaus-inspired bath is a striking, sky-lit space, the walk-in shower open the sky. The primary bedroom is projected into the views from a private deck overlooking Eureka Valley & Downtown. 1 car garage. This unique, bespoke residence, Legally 2-Units is subject to tenants rights. Walk to coffee, parks - city culture abounds!

text: Step into timeless character and comfort with this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home, built in 1912. From its classic architectural details to its magical garden and views, this home offers a perfect blend of vintage charm and everyday livability. Inside, you'll find warm hardwood floors, original stained glass, and abundant natural light throughout. The inviting living room flows into a formal dining area with wood-burning fireplace, ideal for hosting or cozy evenings in. A thoughtfully updated kitchen offers modern conveniences including an island with bonus sink, gas range, Subzero fridge and abundant cabinetry. Step outside to discover your private garden retreat-lush landscaping, mature plantings, and a quiet sitting area that create a serene space for morning coffee or an evening glass of wine. Both bedrooms are generously sized, with the primary bedroom boasting a wood-burning fireplace. The second bedroom enjoys lovely period detail windows and a generous window seat. A full bath with separate tub and shower and an additional half bath adds flexibility and function. A bonus room with built-in cabinets and a cozy window seat is an ideal work-from-home environment that is both efficient and inviting. On the top level is a spacious, flexible space with windows framing stunning views of downtown and St. Ignatius church. A charming stained-glass door leads to an expansive view deck with a unique connection to both the twinkling lights of the city and the colors of the sunset. Additional features include garage parking, ample storage, washer dryer hookups and effortless access to Cole Valley shops and restaurants, Golden Gate Park and transportation. This unique home offers the exceptional combination of historical charm and modern living in a coveted location.

text: Welcome to Westwood Park's Finest! Perched at the corner of Miramar & Northwood, this thoughtfully renovated home offers over 3000 Sq feet of living space on 3 floors. Westwood Park was developed between 1917-1923 by Baldwin & Howell, a prominent SF developer at the time. 800 Miramar was one of the first homes to be built. Built in 1918, this bungalow style home sits on a prominent Southwest facing, 5000+ sq foot corner lot. The property is completely detached & features a free standing, two car garage, + two additional off street parking spots. The main level features a foyer, large, renovated eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, living room + fireplace, two bedrooms & full bath. The current owners expanded the home to include two en suite bedrooms downstairs, an exercise room, laundry area & vault. The piece de resistance is the top floor: a large, airy den or office space with windows on all sides. Take in views from the Bay to the Pacific & the surrounding neighborhood. This room also has a gas burning fireplace. The hardscaped patio is nicely sheltered from the wind. It features slate tile, a Japanese elm, & koi pond w/waterfall. The home has dual pane Marvin windows throughout. Hardwood floors, architectural windows, & coved ceilings contribute to the home's timeless elegance

text: Modern Home with Panoramic Views and Contemporary Elegance! Perched on a quiet block and privately situated, this beautifully renovated modern home offers breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean, Olympic Golf Course, San Bruno Mountains, South Hills, and the Minnie & Lovie Ward Recreation Center. Thoughtfully updated with today's modern amenities, the home features 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 luxurious bathrooms. The expansive living room, kitchen, and dining area are designed for both comfort and style, with large windows framing stunning vistas and filling the space with natural light. The open-concept layout flows effortlessly into a deep, modern backyard with multiple terraced levels, perfect for entertaining, gardening, or relaxing in privacy. Bright and airy throughout, the home also boasts multiple indoor and outdoor entertainment areas, offering versatility for both intimate gatherings and larger celebrations. Conveniently located near BART, MUNI, freeways, parks, schools, H Mart, and other shops, this home combines serene living with unbeatable access to urban amenities.

The show stopping fourth level solarium incorporates innovative suspended planters with integrated irrigation for plant lovers, opening to a stunning roof deck with spectacular sunrises and 180 views spanning San Francisco and the Bay. The garden level continues the indoor-outdoor lifestyle with a multi-functional room and a third en-suite bedroom, both accessing a private manicured yard.

Great location: walk to GG Park, playground, nearby schools, restaurants, shops & convenient transportation. A must see!

While these units are in excellent condition, they have been modestly updated thus far, providing a new owner with significant upside potential upon turnover. This property is still owned by the family that built it in 1978 and has never been offered for sale. This is a truly rare opportunity to purchase a generational asset in a premier location.

Don't miss your chance to own this special home.
